__doc__: Ordered gesture combos. A combo fires when its 'pattern' gestures happen in order within 'window' seconds. 'action' is takeoff, land, cycle_mode, speed_up, speed_down, spin360, return_home, estop, orbit, or fly_north/south/east/west. While combos are configured, single-gesture commands that appear in a pattern are held back 'single_delay' seconds and cancelled if the combo lands. Combos are OFF right now. (The two-finger vertical<->horizontal wiper is a separate built-in detector - src/finger_swing.py - not a combo.)
